messages.content: 今天美國的黃金價格是多少？

function.name: calculate_Bond_Price
function.description: Calculate the bond price given the face value, coupon rate, required rate of return, and maturity period. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

Face_Value.description: The face value of the bond. This is a float type value.

Coupon_rate.description: The coupon rate of the bond. This is a float type value.

Required_return.description: The required rate of return on the bond. This is a float type value.

maturity_years.description: The number of years to maturity of the bond.

message.content:
抱歉，我目前無法即時查詢最新的市場數據。您可以參考以下常用來源來取得美國今日黃金價格：

| 資料來源 | 連結 | 特色 |
|----------|------|------|
| Bloomberg | https://www.bloomberg.com/markets | 提供即時行情、新聞與分析 |
| Reuters | https://www.reuters.com/markets | 全球金融資訊，含黃金報價 |
| Kitco | https://www.kitco.com/ | 專門的貴金屬市場網站，提供實時價格圖表 |
| Investing.com | https://www.investing.com/ | 提供多種貨幣、商品即時報價與技術分析工具 |

若您需要更精確的數字，建議直接訪問上述網站或使用金融資訊服務（如 Bloomberg Terminal、Reuters Eikon 等）以獲得最新行情。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "今天美國的黃金價格是多少？" (What is today's gold price in the US?). We need to provide the current price. We don't have real-time data. We can approximate or say we don't have real-time data. But we can provide a typical answer: "I don't have real-time data." We can also mention typical sources like Bloomberg, Reuters, etc. We can provide a general explanation. There's no function to call. So we respond with an apology and suggestion.
